notes: No finish, on purpose: a section-chain map whose end is not labelled (see README.md and NOT_COURSES in examples/headless_imported.gd). This file exists for its spawn (below) and its conditional teleports: 185 of the map's 409 teleports sit on its blocks behind `filter_activator`, the anti-standing trap, and 184 trigger_multiples pulse the name that filter passes.

conditional_teleports.note: the map's anti-standing trap: a trigger_multiple on each block sets the player's name to the one this filter passes after a delay and resets it after another, so the teleport only fires on a player who stood on a block too long. This game does not run the map's outputs, so imported unconditionally it fired on every landing. Dropped; standing still is allowed here and costs the player time instead

zones.note: where the spawn room sends you (2026-10-11): the 64 team spawns stand in a sealed tools/toolsblack box whose floor is a teleport to `spawn_tele`; until then the importer had that floor send back to the spawn and every player was held in the black box
